newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: SOCCER-PENPIX OF UAE ASIAN CUP FINALISTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PENPIX OF UAE ASIAN CUP FINALISTS.

text.p: Following are penpix of United Arab Emirates players most likely to play against Saudi Arabia in the Asian Cup final on Saturday:

Muhsin Fairouz (17): A 29-year-old goalkeeper who will be playing his 101 game for the UAE in the final. He has made crucial saves in the run up to the final but at times tends to overdo things. Club: Al Sharjah.
Abdel Hussain (2): Defender, 22, who has 21 caps. Scored his first goal for his country from a long-range free-kick in extra time against Iraq in the quarter finals. Club: Al Shaab.
Munther Abdulla (3): Defender, 23, who has 17 caps. Yet to score for country. Club: Al Wasl.
Abdulrahman Al Haddad (4): Defender, 29, who played 70 times for country, scoring six goals. He recovered from an injury earlier in the tournament. Club: Al Sharjah.
Ismail Ismail (6): Defender, 24, with 69 caps and four goals to his name. Club: Al Wasl.
Bakhit Saad (7): A 26-year-old tireless midfielder. He has 69 caps and 28 goals -- including one in tournament -- to his name. Club: Al Shabab.
Hassan Mubarak (12): Midfielder, 26, who only became a regular in the side at the tournament. He has played 15 times for country and yet to score. Club: Kalba.
Mohamed Mohamed (15): Midfielder, 26, with 40 caps and nine goals to his credit. He is a dead-ball expert. Club: Al Nasr.

Hassan Ahmed (16): The 23-year-old midfielder is a national hero after scoring three goals in the competition. Before playing in the five matches at the tournament, he had played only 10 times for the UAE without scoring. Club: Kalba.

Adnan Al Talyani (10): The 32-year-old veteran striker and team captain is among the more gifted players in the UAE squad. He has played 120 times for his country, scoring 68 goals including two in the competition. Club: Al Shaab.
Zuhair Bkhait (11): Striker, 29, who hit the net 50 times in 97 appearences for the UAE. Been restricted to the subs bench for much of the competition. Club: Al Wasl.
Abdulaziz Mohamed: A 19-year-old striker who has 15 caps and three goals. Club: Al-Sharjah.
Khamis Saad (14): Striker, 27, who played 74 times for the UAE, scoring 30 goals including one this month. Club: Al Shabab.
